text: だって　わたしの　ゆめは　ナツメさん　みたいに　かわいくて　かっこいい　エスパー　しょうじょに　なること　なんだから！

structure.jp: ナツメさん　みたいに
かわいくて　かっこいい　エスパー　しょうじょに　なること
structure.en: to become a cute and cool Psychic girl

patterns.name: 〜こと (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: こと after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like 'to become' or 'becoming'. なること = 'to become'

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: なんだ is the spoken form of なのだ, which gives an explanation, and から adds 'because'. Together they insist on her reason. なること　なんだから = 'because it's to become one, you see!'

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: かわいくて　かっこいい
patterns.explanation: Changing い to くて joins one describing word to the next, like 'and'. かわいくて　かっこいい = 'cute and cool'
